tours.name: Explore Salary Structures and Salary Rules

name_i18n.en_US: Explore Salary Structures and Salary Rules

tours.description: Learn how payroll is organised: how a salary structure groups the rules that compute each payslip, and how to read the rules a structure contains.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how payroll is organised: how a salary structure groups the rules that compute each payslip, and how to read the rules a structure contains.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: The Payroll app is where contracts, payslips and the rules that compute them are managed.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payroll app is where contracts, payslips and the rules that compute them are managed.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: Configuration holds the settings that control how salaries are calculated, including structures and rules.

description_i18n.en_US: Configuration holds the settings that control how salaries are calculated, including structures and rules.

steps.title: Structures
steps.description: A salary structure is a set of rules applied to the payslips of the employees who use it. Different groups of staff, such as employees and workers, can follow different structures.

description_i18n.en_US: A salary structure is a set of rules applied to the payslips of the employees who use it. Different groups of staff, such as employees and workers, can follow different structures.

steps.title: Open a group
steps.content: Click a group name to show its structures.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a group name to show its structures.

steps.description: Structures are grouped by structure type. Click a group to expand it and see the structures inside.

description_i18n.en_US: Structures are grouped by structure type. Click a group to expand it and see the structures inside.

steps.title: Open a structure
steps.content: Click a structure to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a structure to open it.

steps.description: Opening a structure shows its settings, such as the payslip name and the pay schedule, and the list of rules it applies.

description_i18n.en_US: Opening a structure shows its settings, such as the payslip name and the pay schedule, and the list of rules it applies.

steps.title: Salary Rules tab
steps.description: The Salary Rules tab lists every rule used to compute a payslip for this structure, in the order they are calculated.

description_i18n.en_US: The Salary Rules tab lists every rule used to compute a payslip for this structure, in the order they are calculated.

steps.title: Read the rules
steps.content: Look at the Category column, then click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the Category column, then click it to continue.

steps.description: Each rule has a name, a code and a category such as Basic, Allowance or Deduction. The category tells you how the amount is used, for example whether it adds to or reduces the net salary.

description_i18n.en_US: Each rule has a name, a code and a category such as Basic, Allowance or Deduction. The category tells you how the amount is used, for example whether it adds to or reduces the net salary.

steps.title: Finish
steps.content: Click the structure name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the structure name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: You can now read a structure and its rules. Use the breadcrumb to go back to the list of structures at any time.

description_i18n.en_US: You can now read a structure and its rules. Use the breadcrumb to go back to the list of structures at any time.
